name: City Council Regular Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN  RAY PEARL  NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, JUNE 10, 2026 - 6:30 p.m.
  .

  ATTEND OR WATCH THE MEETING
  Members of the public may attend in-person in the Council Chambers or watch the meeting
  through Zoom, City Website (Live Stream) or Cable TV Channel 10. City Council Chamber doors
  open 30 minutes before the meeting start time.

  PUBLIC COMMENT/SPEAKERS
  Members of the public may express comments to the City Council in person at the meeting or
  may submit written comments before or at the meeting. Submit a Public Speaker card or Written
  Comment card to the City Clerk prior to the public comment portion of that item. Public speakers
  are limited to three minutes unless the presiding officer sets a different limit for meeting
  management purposes. An oral summary of written comments may be given at the discretion of
  the presiding officer.

  Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at cityclerk@wlv.org no later than
  4:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
  meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

  ZOOM VIEWING ONLY:
  Members of the public watching through Zoom will not have the ability to provide comments on
  agenda items. Zoom is offered strictly as an additional viewing platform. To provide comments,
  see Public Comments/Speakers section.

  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/84070910557
  Webinar ID: 840 7091 0557
  One-tap Mobile:
  +16469313860,,84070910557# OR +13017158592,,84070910557#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 900 9128 OR +1 646 931 3860 OR +1 301 715 8592
 Unless the City Council holds a teleconference meeting under AB 2449 (2022) guidelines, the
meeting will not be cancelled if technical issues occur.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
Packets.

CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Honig, Davis, Pearl, Mayor Pro Tem Halpern,
  Mayor McSweeney

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:
APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of May 13, 2026 City Council Study Session and Regular Meeting

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS:

1.  Westlake Village Orchestra – 20th Anniversary Recognition

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the City Council on non-agenda items that are within the Council’s
subject matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit (three minutes unless a different limit is set by the
presiding officer for meeting management purposes). Public Comments may be presented via a written
comment, see Page 1 for deadline. Complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk to be called
to speak while in the Council Chambers.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: Updated Status Reports on City Council Committee
Meetings, where the items remain in the Committee.

1.  ENVIRONMENTAL COMMITTEE REPORT - AWARD OF NEIGHBORHOOD
  BEAUTIFICATION GRANT TO WESTLAKE COLONY HOMEOWNERS
  ASSOCIATION - Award a Neighborhood Beautification Grant to the Westlake
  Colony Homeowners Association in the amount of $21.035.00; and authorize the
  Mayor to sign and execute the Neighborhood Beautification Grant Program
  Agreement on behalf of the City
 PUBLIC HEARINGS: None

CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will
be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the
Consent Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective June 1, 2026 in the amount of
  $ 850,473.57 (Warrant Register is on file with the City Clerk)

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1.  CONDUCTING THE NOVEMBER 3, 2026 GENERAL MUNICIPAL
  ELECTION FOR THREE COUNCILMEMBER POSITIONS; RESOLUTION
  NOS. 2454-26, 2455-26 and 2456-26 - Adopt Resolution No. 2454-26 to
  hold a General Municipal Election on Tuesday, November 3, 2026 for three
  City Council positions, adopt Resolution No. 2455-26 consolidating a
  General Municipal Election with the Statewide General Election to be held
  on November 3 2026, and adopt Resolution No. 2456-26 related to
  Candidate Statement Regulations.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2454-26: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE, CALIFORNIA, CALLING FOR THE HOLDING
  OF A GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION TO BE HELD ON TUESDAY,
  NOVEMBER 3, 2026, FOR THE ELECTION OF CERTAIN OFFICERS AS
  REQUIRED BY THE PROVISIONS OF THE LAWS OF THE STATE OF
  CALIFORNIA RELATING TO GENERAL LAW CITIES

  RESOLUTION NO. 2455-26: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE, CALIFORNIA, REQUESTING THE BOARD OF
  SUPERVISORS OF THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES TO CONSOLIDATE A
  GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION TO BE  HELD ON TUESDAY,
  NOVEMBER 3, 2026, WITH THE STATEWIDE GENERAL ELECTION TO BE
  HELD ON THE DATE PURSUANT TO SECTION 10403 OF THE ELECTIONS
  CODE

  RESOLUTION NO. 2456-26: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE, CALIFORNIA, ADOPTING REGULATIONS FOR
  CANDIDATES FOR ELECTIVE OFFICE, PERTAINING TO MATERIALS
  SUBMITTED TO THE ELECTORATE AND THE COSTS OF THE CANDIDATES
  STATEMENT FOR THE GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION

  2.  ROAD REPAIR AND ACCOUNTABILITY ACT OF 2017 (SENATE BILL
  1) PROJECT LIST FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026-27; RESOLUTION NO.
  2456-26 - Adopt Resolution No. 2457-26, identifying the Fiscal Year 2026-
  27 Annual Street Improvement Project to utilize the Road Maintenance and
  Rehabilitation Account Funds

  RESOLUTION NO. 2457-26: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE IDENTIFYING THE FISCAL YEAR 2026-27
  ANNUAL STREET IMPROVEMENT PROJECT TO UTILIZE ROAD
  MAINTENANCE AND REHABILITATION ACCOUNT FUNDS
   3.  APPROVAL OF A FIVE-YEAR LEASE AGREEMENT WITH CANON
  U.S.A. INC. FOR TWO IMAGE FORCE PRINTER/COPIER MACHINES -
  approve a five-year equipment lease agreement with Canon U.S.A. Inc. for
  two Image Force copier/printer machines

OLD BUSINESS:

1.  ADOPTION OF PROPOSED BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026-27;
  RESOLUTION NO. 2458-26 – Adopt Resolution No. 2458-26 adopting and
  appropriating funds for the operating and capital budgets and Investment Policy
  for Fiscal Year 2026-27, closing appropriations for Fiscal Year 2025-26, delegates
  contract execution authority to the City Manager and establishes appropriations
  limits as required by the California Constitution

  RESOLUTION NO. 2458-26: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE ADOPTING AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS FOR
  OPERATING AND CAPITAL BUDGETS AND INVESTMENT POLICY FOR FISCAL
  YEAR COMMENCING JULY 1, 2026, CLOSING APPROPRIATIONS FOR FISCAL YEAR
  2025-2026, DELEGATING  CONTRACT  EXECUTION  AUTHORITY,  AND
  ESTABLISHING THE APPROPRIATIONS LIMIT AS REQUIRED BY THE CALIFORNIA
  CONSTITUTION

NEW BUSINESS:

1.  SUMMARY OF SENATE BILL 707 BROWN ACT CHANGES AND ADOPTION
  OF THREE POLICIES: TELEPHONIC/INTERNET SERVICE DISRUPTION,
  RESOLUTION NO 2459-26; RULES OF DECORUM, RESOLUTION NO 2460-
  26; REASONABLE ACCOMMODATIONS FOR REMOTE ATTENDANCE FOR
  A MEMBER OF THE CITY COUNCIL; RESOLUTION NO 2461-26 - Adopt
  Resolution No. 2459-26 to adopt the mandated SB 707 Telephonic/Internet
  Service Disruption Policy, adopt Resolution No. 2460-26 adopting Rules of
  Decorum and adopt Resolution No. 2461-26 adopting Reasonable
  Accommodations for Remote Attendance by City Councilmembers Policy.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2459-26: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING POLICY RELATED TO DISRUPTION OF CITY
  TELEPHONIC OR INTERNET SERVICE DURING CITY COUNCIL HYBRID MEETINGS
  AS REQUIRED BY SENATE BILL 707 WHICH AMENDED PARTS OF THE RALPH M.
  BROWN ACT (GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54950 et seq.)

  RESOLUTION NO. 2460-26: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING POLICY RELATED TO RULES OF DECORUM
  FOR PUBLIC CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS

  RESOLUTION NO. 2461-26: RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING POLICY RELATED TO REASONABLE
  ACCOMMODATION FOR REMOTE ATTENDANCE AT CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS
  FOR A MEMBER OF THE LEGISLATIVE BODY
 2.  INTRODUCTION OF ORDINANCE TO ESTABLISH PUBLIC RIGHT OF WAY
  ENCROACHMENT REGULATIONS; ORDINANCE NO. 315-26; AND UPDATE
  OF ENCROACHMENT PERMIT FEES - Ordinance No. 315-26 be introduced by
  title only, that further reading be waived, and that a Public Hearing and second
  reading of the ordinance be set for June 24, 2026.

  ORDINANCE NO. 315-26: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  AMENDING THE WESTLAKE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL CODE TO UPDATE PUBLIC
  RIGHT-OF-WAY ENCROACHMENT REGULATIONS CHAPTER 7.5 PUBLIC RIGHT-
  OF-WAY ENCROACHMENTS AND APPROVING A CEQA EXEMPTION
  DETERMINATION

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, June 4, 2026 at 6:15 p.m. on the City’s website and in the
Posting Board at City Hall.

  City Clerk
  June 4, 2026
